features.quote: Max assistant turns: 30 / Max tool calls: 80 / Max wall-clock time: 20 minutes
Model enters an obvious pathological loop and an external guard fires, e.g. same command failure 5 times with no intervening file change.
Hard cap: 25 assistant turns or 60 tool calls.
Use neutral wording. Do not tell the model it is expected to fail. Do not shame or pressure the model.
